conditions.description: Supported fellows must be postdoctoral researchers at the call deadline, i.e. in possession of a doctoral degree. Applicants who have successfully and unconditionally defended their doctoral thesis before the call deadline but have not yet been formally awarded the degree are also eligible.

At the call deadline, supported researchers must have a maximum of 8 years full-time-equivalent experience in research, measured from the date of award of the doctoral degree (career breaks and non-research experience excluded).

Mobility rule: the recruited researcher must not have resided or carried out their main activity in the country of the beneficiary (for EF) or the outgoing host organisation (for GF) for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the call deadline. Refugees under the Geneva Convention are exempt.

European Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to researchers of any nationality. Global Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to nationals or long-term residents of EU Member States or Horizon Europe Associated Countries.

Admissibility conditions (Annex A), eligibility of countries and applicants (Annex B), and financial and operational capacity (Annex C) are as described in the Horizon Europe Work Programme General Annexes.

The beneficiary must recruit the postdoctoral researcher under an employment contract (or equivalent direct contract) with full social security coverage; a 'fixed-amount fellowship' with halved living allowance is permitted only exceptionally where national law prohibits employment.
